Introduction

Bang Junhyuk, also known as Win, is South Korean rappers under TOP Media. First appearing on the 2018 survival show, Under Nineteen, he debuted in 2020 as the leader rapper of MCND. In 2025, he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
